summary: Just never understood why people would be against trying to get more people to vote and increase turn out. Sounds so unAmerican to be so against democracy. More people voting should always be a good thing.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Just never understood why people would be against trying to get more people to vote and increase turn out. Sounds so unAmerican to be so against democracy.

More people voting should always be a good thing.
